ITEM 1 | Dark brown to near-black charred pieces with glossy, slightly caramelized surface, irregular chunky shape about 3-4 cm long, clustered at upper right of plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale beige-tan slices with dense, fibrous grain and a few darker browned edges, elongated strips about 6-7 cm long and 2 cm thick, stacked together on right side of plate | 70
ITEM 3 | Dark reddish-brown glazed pieces with matte-to-glossy sheen and slightly dry edges, small wedge-shaped chunks about 3 cm across, lying near the center-right of the cluster | 35
ITEM 4 | Small bright green herb or vegetable fragments with thin strands, scattered in small amount between the pale slices, about 1-2 cm each | 5
